Extra-ocular injection of botulinum A toxin has been used to weaken an overactive extra-ocular eye mus- cle as an aid to eye realignment; repeated injections may be required. Long-acting parasympathomimetic miotics such as demecarium, dyflos, and ecothiopate have been used in the diagnosis and management of convergent stra- bismus due to excessive accommodation. Centrally-acting drugs such as levodopa and citicoline have also been in- vestigated. With any form of treatment care has to be taken not to induce amblyopia in the healthy eye. References. 1.
